backend/main.mo: Motoko canister with access control, blob storage mixins, user profile management, and validated CRUD logic for admin and personal records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted list of brief summaries for all major frontend components and feature modules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH-themed design tokens and dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root component toggling between personal records page and admin panel with header navigation.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, theming, and external attribution link.
frontend/src/components/PersonalRecords/: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states and query cache clearing.
Authentication gate that blocks access until the user signs in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminPanel.t: Admin-only CRUD interface with login form, record list, detail panel, and create/edit/delete flows.
frontend/src/features/admin/queries.ts: React Query hook fetching admin records via listAllAdmin when authenticated.
frontend/src/features/personalRecords/mu: React Query mutations for creating, updating, and deleting a personal record, including image upload handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/features/personalRecords/qu: Provides a React Query hook to fetch the user's personal record, enabled only when identity and actor are ready.
frontend/src/features/records/emptyState: Components providing empty-state UIs for no records or no selected record.
Defines React Query mutations for creating, updating, and deleting records with image upload support and admin cache updates.
frontend/src/features/records/queries.ts: Indicates that all record queries are admin-only and previous public queries were removed.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordDeta: UI component that displays detailed information for a personal record with edit and delete actions.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordForm: Form component for creating or editing a record with validation, image upload, and submit handling.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordImag: Image upload field with preview, file selection, and removal controls.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsLis: Displays a selectable list of records with avatars, loading skeletons, and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/features/records/RecordsPag: Main page orchestrating viewing, creating, editing, and deleting the user's personal record.
frontend/src/features/records/types.ts: Provides record form data types and converters between form data and backend Data format.
frontend/src/features/records/validators: Implements validation rules for record form fields including text, numeric ranges, dates, and image size.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, handling login, identity persistence, and auth-client configuration.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and theme extensions.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, requirements, and pending feature requests for separating personal records storage from the admin panel.
